# `formal/vendor` — the implementers' models, vendored

The models the implementing repositories keep of their own parts, copied here so that this repository's end-to-end account can name them by bytes and commit. [`VENDOR.tsv`](VENDOR.tsv) lists every vendored file in this directory, in `formal/onion_layers/` and in `formal/cewp_node/catalog/`. For each one it gives the repository, ref and commit it came from, its path there, the sha256 of the upstream bytes, and the sha256 of the bytes here. Where the two differ, the `note` says why (in every case so far, CC section numbers re-cut to this edition's, or comment wording).

| Directory | From | What it models | Where the path from screen to packet uses it |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`client/csd5`](client/csd5/) | CIRISClient `main` | one TLA+ module per CSD/5 card, generated by the client's checker: a screen's states and the exits from each | the screen: what a person may do at each state |
| [`agent/h3ere_ctxflow`](agent/h3ere_ctxflow/) | CIRISAgent `feat/h3ere-context-flow` (PR #1366, not yet merged) | what each stage of one agent thought receives, the contract that fixes where context is lost, and a check of contract against measured | the agent: from what it is shown to the act it proposes |
| [`server/add_device`](server/add_device/) | CIRISServer `main` | a new device joining its owner's identity, under careless, live, safety and Sybil configurations | the key plane: a person's second device |
| [`edge`](edge/) | CIRISEdge `main` | the transport tiers, rooms over the onion, the event path, the reply lane, the retry schedule (quantitative) | transport: load and capacity, not security |
| [`../onion_layers`](../onion_layers/) | CIRISEdge `feat/onion-fsd` | the anonymous tier's layer deal (TLA+ and Lean) | transport: the onion tier |
| [`../cewp_node/catalog`](../cewp_node/catalog/) | CIRISServer `main` | the twenty topologies the harness stands up on real nodes | the node as a whole |

**Checked.** `python3 tools/vendor_models.py --check` (CI) holds every listed file to its recorded hash, refuses a file under a vendored directory that the manifest does not list, and refuses an edit made here without a note. `--upstream`, run where the repositories are cloned, re-hashes each file at its recorded commit and names the files whose ref has moved on since. After a re-vendor, `--write` re-hashes the local copies.

**Running them.** These models run in their own repositories' CI. They are vendored so they can be cited and diffed here, not re-run. The models this repository runs itself are listed in [`../README.md`](../README.md).
